name: Universal Motion Lab checkpoint 1
scope: Code-first universal marker test template; placeholder visuals. No avatar or motion-core edits.

design.layout: sticky title, section, Behind/Front/Side/Top/Angled and Reset; full-screen stage; Test videos cards below
design.floor: solid off-white #eeeae2; no grid; lighter than clay #b9b2a6
design.shared_template: motion-lab/src/page.js; configure only title/section/videos in src/main.js
design.touch: floating analog left stick, right look, pinch zoom, simultaneous move/look
design.gamepad: browser standard mapping; left analog move, right look; radial dead zone 0.12
design.movement: createMoveController -> advance(frameSeconds, moveX, moveZ), scaled world-space vector; read x/z/facing/speed/mode
design.marker: disc with facing arrow; camera follows marker

validation.passed: ESDF/arrows, JLIK, mouse drag/wheel, touch analog/right-look/pinch, three standard gamepad identities with analog strength/deadzone/look/disconnect, five camera views, Reset, sticky header, five device layouts, video playback/seeking, no page errors
validation.gamepad_scope: Gamepad API simulated in browser tests; physical devices not available
validation.motion_core: source SHA-256 unchanged; npm run test:motion-core completes (old external comparison repo unavailable)
validation.video_capture: actual shared keyboard and gamepad input through motion-core; 3-second MP4 clips
validation.frozen_smoke: Passed keyboard movement, Reset and local video playback; no page errors or requests outside the checkpoint.
